draft.flavor: A sudden, biting chill that shatters the resolve of the frozen.
draft.name: Frostbite Impact
draft.rationale: The action applies a freezing status (freezing) to the target, which directly enables the bonus damage from the chill-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: A sudden, biting chill that leaves the target shivering and vulnerable.
draft.name: Frostbite Touch
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect and a freezing status, which directly enables the bonus damage from the chill-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: A spreading sickness that turns the target's own vitality against them.
draft.name: Vile Contagion
draft.rationale: The action applies multiple status-inflicting effects (bloodletting, spores, poison, or withering) to ensure the target is afflicted, thereby triggering the bonus damage from the rot-punisher payoff.

draft.flavor: A lingering corruption that marks the target for inevitable decay.
draft.name: Blighted Mark
draft.rationale: The action applies a mark (marking) and a rotting status (rotting) to the target, which directly enables the bonus damage from the rot-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: A surge of inner strength that fortifies the spirit before the clash.
draft.name: Vanguard's Resolve
draft.rationale: The action provides a self-buff to maximum health and general fortitude, serving as a foundational defensive boost for any creature entering combat.

draft.flavor: A steadfast posture that hardens the spirit and the skin against incoming blows.
draft.name: Ironclad Resolve
draft.rationale: The action provides both armor plating and increased maximum health, serving as a robust defensive self-buff.

draft.flavor: A sudden hardening of the spirit that turns incoming blows into mere echoes.
draft.name: Ironclad Resolve
draft.rationale: This defensive action provides a multi-layered protection for the self, combining status resistance (stalwart), critical hit mitigation (evd-harden), and physical armor plating (plating).

draft.flavor: A steadfast posture that hardens the spirit against incoming blows.
draft.name: Ironclad Resolve
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive boost to the creature's maximum health and increases its resistance to negative status effects, fulfilling the self-targeted defense role.

draft.flavor: A sudden hardening of the exterior that absorbs the brunt of incoming strikes.
draft.name: Ironclad Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides both immediate armor plating and a general increase to the army's defense, fulfilling the defensive, single-target, self-oriented requirement for an early-tier role.

draft.flavor: A sudden surge of fortitude that hardens the collective resolve.
draft.name: Resilient Bastion
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive boost to the entire army (arm-hardening and warding), fitting the multi-target, self-relation, defensive category.

draft.flavor: A sudden influx of life-force that bolsters the spirit of those nearby.
draft.name: Vitality Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target support role by increasing the maximum health of allies and enhancing the amount of health restored when they receive healing.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic pulse of vitality that reinforces the resolve of those nearby.
draft.name: Resilient Echo
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target support role by applying a healing effect (mending) and a general defensive buff (resilience) to allies.

draft.flavor: A harmonious surge of vitality that bolsters the resolve of those nearby.
draft.name: Resilient Chorus
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive boost to the entire army (warding) and restores health to allies (mending), fulfilling the multi-target support role.

draft.flavor: A sudden rush of life that mends the spirit and fortifies the flesh.
draft.name: Vitality Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides a burst of healing (mending) and increases the target's maximum health (vitality), serving as a strong early-tier support role for an ally.

draft.flavor: A sudden rush of restorative energy that mends wounds and bolsters the spirit.
draft.name: Vitality Surge
draft.rationale: The action combines mending (healing on grant) and life-surge (increased health restored on grant) to provide a potent support effect for allies.

draft.flavor: A momentary lapse in physical presence, leaving only a blur behind.
draft.name: Sudden Displacement
draft.rationale: The action provides a self-targeted movement effect that combines evasion (evd-shift) with an increase in speed/attack rate (quickening), allowing the creature to reposition rapidly.

draft.flavor: A burst of momentum that propels the user forward.
draft.name: Sudden Surge
draft.rationale: The action combines a boost to attack rate (tempo-haste) with an increase in advance speed (swiftness), fitting the movement category and the self-target mode.

draft.flavor: A sudden, coordinated surge that pushes the front line forward.
draft.name: Vanguard Advance
draft.rationale: The action targets all creatures to increase their movement speed via tempo-surge and tempo-stampede, facilitating a rapid advance across the battlefield.

draft.flavor: A rapid, rhythmic acceleration that propels the entire formation forward.
draft.name: Sudden Surge
draft.rationale: The action targets all creatures and applies both a surge in zombie advance and a faster attack rate, fulfilling the movement category for the whole army.

draft.flavor: A burst of kinetic energy that propels the user forward.
draft.name: Sudden Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based boost to speed, utilizing both swiftness and tempo haste to increase the rate of advance/attack.

draft.flavor: A pervasive miasma that weakens the resolve and vitality of all nearby foes.
draft.name: Lingering Blight
draft.rationale: The action applies the blighting status to all enemies in the area and uses affliction to increase the potency of any statuses currently or subsequently applied.

draft.flavor: A searing fissure that leaves the ground molten and treacherous.
draft.name: Lava Vein
draft.rationale: The action targets a row of enemies, using terraforming to scorch the ground with lava and firelining to lay a line of fire, creating a hazardous area effect.

draft.flavor: A freezing pillar of air that leaves the ground brittle and the enemies sluggish.
draft.name: Frostbound Column
draft.rationale: The action targets an area in a column shape, applying both a chill effect and a freeze effect to enemies within that space.

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent eruption of life that chokes the very ground.
draft.name: Verdant Overgrowth
draft.rationale: The action covers a square area to apply a utility effect (spawning plants) and an offensive status (infesting with spores), fulfilling the area-of-effect requirement for a status-type action.

draft.flavor: A thick, emerald mist that chokes the air and takes root in the lungs of the unwary.
draft.name: Overgrowth Spore
draft.rationale: The action covers a rectangular area to apply a status that infests targets with spores and simultaneously applies a withering effect, fulfilling the status/area/enemy requirements.
